reasoning: The icon clearly depicts an open book with a turning page crossed out by a diagonal slash. While a plain open book is far more common for reading tasks, the slashed variant fits tasks about culling bookshelves, dropping books from a reading list, cancelling book subscriptions or library holds, and closed-book study. At tiny sizes the turning page and slash can slightly crowd the center and resemble a folded map.
